jobs.description:
Votre équipe

FundPartner Solutions propose une gamme complète de services d’administration de fonds et de création de fonds sur mesure. Ses équipes de spécialistes apportent leurs compétences en matière de domiciliation, d’enregistrement et de gouvernance de fonds, ainsi que de gestion des risques et de contrôle du respect des directives de placement.

En tant que Business Compliance & Operations Liaison Officer vous serez responsable de la gestion et de la coordination des projets entre les diverses équipes de la société ainsi qu’avec les prestataires externes de type gestionnaires de fortune collective. Vous assurerez un support opérationnel de qualité, coordonnerez les flux d’information et veillerez à la conformité des processus liés à l’administration et à la gouvernance des fonds d’investissement de droit suisse. Ce rôle est essentiel pour garantir une efficience optimale et le respect des exigences réglementaires lors de la mise en place et du suivi de fonds d’investissements.

Votre rôle

• Agir comme point de contact principal pour les équipes internes (juridique, compliance, risques, administration fonds) sur les aspects opérationnels et administratifs.
• Gérer la coordination légale et opérationnelle des projets liés à la mise en place de nouveaux fonds ou mandats de gestion, en collaboration avec les départements internes et externes (gérants, autorité, audit, etc).
• Coordonner et suivre les projets clients, en veillant à la collecte des documents, au respect des délais et à la bonne communication entre les parties prenantes pour assurer leur mise en œuvre.
• Assurer la mise à jour, la gestion et la publication des données des fonds de placement dans les systèmes internes, ainsi que la production de rapports réglementaires et opérationnels.
• Gérer la coordination et la préparation administrative des demandes provenant de diverses autorités (FINMA, AFC, etc) ainsi que des demandes d’audit interne et externe participer aux activités et tâches liées à la gouvernance d’entreprise.
• Soutenir opérationnellement les équipes dans le suivi et l’implémentation des documents et des contrats de la société et participer au processus clé de vérification nécessaires pour les divers processus de la société.
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus, à l’optimisation des outils de travail et à la préparation de documents pour les clients et comités internes.

Votre profil

• Solide expérience (5-10 ans) dans le secteur bancaire ou financier, avec formation supérieure (Bachelor ou équivalent).
• Bonne connaissance des produits financiers et des processus opérationnels en environnement financier.
• Maîtrise des réglementations suisses et internationales, avec curiosité et capacité à en comprendre les enjeux.
• Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (l’allemand est un atout), avec de bonnes compétences en communication.
• Maîtrise des outils MS Office et sens de l’organisation pour gérer plusieurs tâches en parallèle.
• Esprit d’équipe, orientation client, rigueur, autonomie et capacité à résoudre des problèmes.
• Domicile en Suisse requis.

Note

BCLO/FH/IM

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

As an intern within the Pictet Asset Services department, you will support the Client Relationship Management (CRO/CRM) teams in their daily activities. This internship will allow you to develop operational, regulatory, and interpersonal skills while contributing to the quality of client service.

• Start date: August/September

• Duration: 12 months

• Employment rate: part-time

• Prerequisite: a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Provide daily operational support to the teams in managing client files: preparation, verification, and follow-up of documents required for account opening, modification, or closure.

• Assist in the management of routine operations: signature verification, execution and monitoring of transactions (orders, payments, fund and asset transfers), management of incoming/outgoing flows, coordination with counterparties, and alerting in case of blockages.

• Participate in the preparation and updating of client files, ensuring information compliance and completeness of supporting documents.

• Support the teams in handling client requests, processing queries, and resolving simple incidents, ensuring rigorous follow-up and effective communication.

• Contribute to verifying the accuracy of transactions and the quality of data entered into internal tools.

• Act as a point of contact for administrative and logistical tasks related to client relationship management.

Your profile

Qualifications and experience:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration or Economics.

• First experience (internship) in a client relationship management role within the financial services industry, idealy in private banking or wealth management

Personal qualities:

• Attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

• Strong interpersonal skills and a team-oriented mindset

• Proactive and solution-oriented approach

Language Skills:

• French: fluent level

• English: good knowledge (written and spoken)

Note

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer-Cloud Engineering
jobs.description:
Your team

Pictet Tech designs, integrates and operates software applications ranging from portfolio management systems and trading platforms to banking and corporate solutions. The division is responsible for some of the Group’s key innovations while sustaining business operations.

You’ll be part of the Cloud Engineering unit. In this unit, we are responsible of streamlining the development experience of product teams by delivering reliable and user-centric platforms covering observability, identity, continuous integration and delivery, release management and cloud capabilities.
You will be embedded within the Release Management Team and will help building and maintaining the tooling used to manage and govern the release management at Pictet Tech .

Your role

• Designing, building and operating a reliable platform providing release management capabilities to development teams.

• Contributing to the promotion of good practices in terms of Release Management within Pictet Group.

• Aligning with developers, infrastructure engineers, cybersecurity and risk managers to apply standards and to provide guidance.

• Performing tasks expected of a platform engineer: development, infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.

Your profile

• You have experience in an engineering role (e.g., software engineer, devops, etc.).

• Proficiency in software craftsmanship practices and full stack development (i.e. Java, Spring, Typescript, Angular, Next.js).

• A well-established background in vibe coding paired with a strong passion for AI coding.

• Knowledge about architecture topics such as integration, security, network, identity and access management.

• Strong interest and knowledge of release management processes.

• As a plus, you have expertise in releasing core banking systems or such complex systems within a highly regulated environment.

• Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Deeply curious and eager to learn technologies and skills.

• Fluent in French and English.

• Swiss resident.

Ref: DOE/CRO/XC

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet’s banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.

By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Start date: ASAP
Duration: 12 months
Employment rate: Full-time or Part-time (80% - 1 school day per week)
Prerequisite : a tripartite internship agreement signed with your school

Your role

• Actively participate in client data remediation plan within the bank’s secure environment, specifically in the client repository.

• Understand account lifecycle processes and perform codifications in accordance with established procedures.

• Work closely with team members and key stakeholders such as Front Office, Compliance, and Legal departments.

• Contribute to the update and improvement of internal procedures.

• Take part in various projects and initiatives aimed at optimizing client data management and supporting the continuous improvement of operational processes.

Your profile

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.

• Meticulous, detail-oriented, and organized, delivering work of the highest quality.

• Dynamic, proactive in problem-solving, and demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit.

• Able to meet deadlines, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously.

• Proficient in standard MS Office products.

• Interest in automation, digitalization, and new technologies, with the ability to design, maintain, or improve automated operational tools (Python, SQL, low-code, LLMs, AI agents, etc.), while adhering to security and compliance standards is a strong asset.

• Fluent in written and spoken French; good command of English. German is an asset.

Votre équipe

Pictet Asset Services (PAS) propose des services de banque dépositaire, des services liés aux fonds ainsi que des solutions de trading à des gérants indépendants, à des gestionnaires de fonds et à des clients institutionnels. Nous maîtrisons en interne chaque dimension de l’asset servicing et concevons des solutions sur mesure, telles que des outils analytiques à valeur ajoutée, des supports à l’élaboration de stratégies de trading et des interfaces utilisateurs, pour offrir une expérience client inégalée.

Votre rôle

- Etre le contact principal pour un portefeuille de gérants indépendants (GI).
- Offrir un support et résoudre les problèmes pour toutes les thématiques opérationnelles et administratives.
- Participer au processus administratif de mise en place des relations GI et de leurs comptes clients, en collaboration avec les chargés de relations (CRM).
- Traiter les opérations de paiement et de transfert, en veillant à ce que les appels de vérification (call-back) soient effectués de manière systématique, et fournir un soutien pour les autres types de transactions, selon les besoins.
- Traiter les demandes (codifications clients internes, cartes de crédit, limites de crédit, conditions spéciales, etc.) et effectuer les saisies dans les workflows correspondants.
- Gérer le flux documentaire (archivage, traitement des formulaires physiques et électroniques).
- Bien connaître les principaux partenaires internes, établir avec eux d’étroites relations et être leur interlocuteur/trice de référence pour le portefeuille.
- Veiller à ce que la prise des appels téléphoniques soit assurée au sein de l’équipe et fournir un soutien pour les tâches administratives.
- Appliquer les politiques et directives en vigueur et accompagner la mise en œuvre de nouvelles règles.

- Formation bancaire ou jugée équivalente.
- Expérience de 5 ans dans le support aux GI.
- Excellentes connaissances transversales au niveau des flux opérationnels.
- Sens du service à la clientèle.
- Solide esprit d’équipe.
- Aptitude à communiquer avec une grande aisance.
- Sens développé des responsabilités, résistance au stress et capacité à gérer des situations délicates.
- Sens de l’organisation et de la gestion des priorités.
- Très bonne connaissance des outils informatiques usuels MS Office/Avaloq.

Your team

Pictet Alternative Advisors (PAA) is a leading alternative investment specialist and wholly owned subsidiary of the Pictet Group, with expertise in hedge funds, private equity and global real estate. With teams based around the world, the PAA teams construct, manage and advise on portfolios of alternative investment solutions for institutional and private clients.

The Group has strong growth ambitions for PAA for the years ahead, notably to expand its product offering to include additional asset classes and to further develop its institutional client base.

Based in Geneva, you will become part of a dynamic five-person team on a six-month temporary contract, assisting with a rise in workload and activity. Your role will involve offering operational support for both hedge fund portfolios and managed accounts.

Your role

• Managing and coordinating operations linked to PAA’s hedge fund products and mandates (NAV calculations, reporting, transactions and client services).
• Providing support to the investment teams, management and internal clients.
• Coordinating with all service providers (legal, tax, compliance, administrators, back office, etc.).
• Monitoring risks and investment constraints.
• Working on various occasional and recurrent projects (e.g. TER calculations).

Your profile

• At least five years’ experience in a similar role in a fund department or with an asset manager.
• Proven practical knowledge of hedge fund operations management.
• Rigorous, with excellent numeracy skills and a keen attention to detail.
• A certain ability to deal with issues/topics with specialists from various businesses (investment managers, tax, compliance, etc.), with excellent verbal and writing skills in these particular situations.
• Advanced user of Excel and generally at ease with new IT systems. Use of Webfolio is a plus.
• At ease expressing yourself in both French and English, with the relevant written proficiency to draft documentation and discuss complex matters with both internal and external parties, whether native speakers or not.
• A strong interest in and/or experience with AI would be an asset.
• Must be resident in Switzerland or willing to relocate.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is a leading independent wealth and asset management firm operating globally. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group maintains operations in 30 offices across key financial centers worldwide, employing more than 4,600 professionals. Pictet has been present in Singapore for over 30 years, supported by a team exceeding 200 employees.

Your role

• Client Management
o Prepare relevant files and account reports for relevant parties prior to meeting with clients.
o Respond to client queries and attend to issues and requests.
o Assist with the administrative support of clients’ relationships, and liaise with all other Departments when required (operational, administration, investment, legal etc.).
o Ensure client's records / accounts / investments / market information are current and information updates are timely maintained with relevant accompanying correspondences and meeting reports.
• Business Development
o Keep the CEO advised of time-sensitive and high-priority issues, ensuring appropriate follow up.
o Liaise with head office for any administrative issues.
o Assist in composing replies for CEO’s review and approval as and when required.
o Ensure fit-and-proper requirements are met (e.g. CPD requirements, complete mandatory training etc.) as stipulated by the regulators.
• Provide strong coordination support across respective Investment Teams within the Bank
• Liaison for Stakeholder teams
o Interface for Risk, Marketing, Compliance, Business Heads, Management Teams, etc both internal and external stakeholders
o Serve as a liaison between CEO, Management Team, internal and external stakeholders.
• Operational Support
o Ensure necessary follow-up actions are promptly taken on various operational matters e.g. deficiency and outstanding documentation.
o Provide efficient day-to-day support (including email inbox management, co-ordination, and other ad hoc tasks).
o Maintain the CEO’s calendar, including scheduling meetings, appointments, business travel arrangements.
o Schedule and organize departmental meetings; assist in the preparation and distribution of meeting agendas and materials.

Your profile

• University degree or equivalent, preferably in Business Management, Economics or Finance.
• Strong understanding of local and regional regulatory climate
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team, with the highest professional work ethic and standards.
• Exercises discretion and maintains confidentiality and sensitivity of matters.
• Strong sense of initiative and resourcefulness to resolve issues as responsibilities and challenges vary.
• Excellent interpersonal, communication and client interfacing skills.
• Strong understanding of financial products and services.
• First class presentation and communication skills
• Familiar with AML and compliance requirements within the Private Banking space.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

The role of the function is to ensure the smooth running of the publishing production according to the SLAs, deadlines and roadmaps in place for in-house and third-party funds. A high level of client support (internal and external) will be expected.

Your role

• Code request as part of fund launch process (LEI, Bloomberg Tickers, etc…).

• Set up, control / update of static and dynamic data.

• Contribute to the efficient and accurate execution of publishing operations.

• Activate and publish request according to registration status.

• Disseminate legal fund documentations, monthly portfolio reports and No NAV calculation reports.

• Manage the chargeback of invoices.

• Collect and organize documents.

• Scan and archive documents and data.

Your profile

Knowledge /Technical skills:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or related

• 2-year experience in banking sector

• Good knowledge in fund operations, process and data analysis

• In-depth knowledge of MS Office and banking softwares (Multifonds, Luxis and Avaloq)

• Excellent knowledge of operational banking and legal perspective for funds

• Good knowledge in Python programming and being at ease with the use of AI Tools would be considered as distinguishing factors.

Soft skills:

• Rigor

• Attention to detail

• Organizational skills

• Team spirit

• Problem solving abilities

Language skills

• Fluent in french and english

Note

We will not accept any CVs from agencies.

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Flexible and modern ways of working

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote the well-being of our employees through a set of flexible working arrangements, ranging from a work-from-home policy for eligible functions to opportunities for annualised part-time leave and extended parental leave.

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.
